verdict.rationale: Token2 keys support FIDO2 PIN setup/change and biometric template enrollment/management (bio models: list, rename, delete, enroll) via the companion app and fido2-manage tool, and browsers prompt for PIN setup when required, confirming on-device user verification is supported. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of biometric UV actually being enforced during authentication (vs. just configurable), and no explicit statement that all Token2 key models include a biometric sensor.
